title: Floralozone attenuates atherosclerotic vascular injury by regulating AMPKalpha/SREBP-1c pathway and down-regulating miR-33-5p.
authors: Guo, Ya-Qi; Zhao, Hong-Lin; Zhao, Jin-Ming; Li, Shan-Shan; Meng, Liu-Wei; Li, Jiao; Qian, Yi-Wen; Li, Yin-Lan; Cui, Bao-Yue; Guo, Shuang; Li, Peng; Li, Chang-Zheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Floralozone通过AMPKalpha/SREBP-1c通路和miR-33-5p调节胆固醇代谢以减轻动脉粥样硬化，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Severe disruption of lipid metabolism in vivo is one of the central mechanisms in the development of atherosclerotic vascular injury (AVI). Reverse cholesterol transport (RCT) plays a pivotal role in eliminating excess cholesterol, preventing lipid deposition in the aorta, and reducing plaque formation associated with AVI. Floralozone (FL) reduces endothelial cell injury in AVI rats by regulating sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) expression. However, FL's potential to prevent AVI by modulating cholesterol metabolism remains unknown. METHODS: In this study, network pharmacology and molecular docking predicted FL's potential targets in AVI protection. AVI rats were induced with a high-sugar, high-fat diet and vitamin D3 injection. FL intervention's effects on aortic pathology and lipid levels were assessed. The expression levels of SREBP-1c, PPARgamma, ABCA1, and ABCG1 were evaluated. Raw264.7 macrophages were induced to form foam cells with ox-LDL, and FL's effects on the AMPKalpha/SREBP-1c pathway and miR-33-5p were investigated. RESULTS: FL reduced lipid levels and SREBP-1c expression, increased HDL-C, promoted ABCA1- and ABCG1-mediated cholesterol efflux, and reduced aortic cholesterol accumulation. The AMPKalpha inhibitor dorsomorphin blocked FL's inhibition of intracellular cholesterol accumulation and SREBP1 down-regulation in foam cells. FL decreased miR-33-5p expression but up-regulated PPARgamma, promoting ABCA1- and ABCG1-mediated cholesterol efflux. However, miR-33-5p mimic reduced FL-induced cholesterol efflux, while miR-33-5p inhibitor increased it. CONCLUSION: FL may promote foam cell cholesterol efflux by modifying the AMPKalpha/SREBP-1c pathway and down-regulating miR-33-5p, which targets cholesterol metabolism genes (PPARgamma, ABCA1, and ABCG1). These findings provide a new insight into the protective effect of FL on AVI.
abstract_zh: 背景：体内脂质代谢的严重紊乱是动脉粥样硬化性血管损伤（AVI）发生发展的核心机制之一。反向胆固醇转运（RCT）在清除多余胆固醇、防止主动脉脂质沉积以及减少与AVI相关的斑块形成中发挥关键作用。Floralozone（FL）通过调节鞘氨醇-1-磷酸（S1P）表达减轻AVI大鼠的内皮细胞损伤。然而，FL通过调节胆固醇代谢预防AVI的潜力尚不清楚。方法：本研究采用网络药理学和分子动力学 (molecular docking) 预测FL在AVI保护中的潜在靶点。通过高糖高脂饮食和维生素D3注射诱导AVI大鼠模型。评估FL干预对主动脉病理和脂质水平的影响。检测SREBP-1c、PPARgamma、ABCA1和ABCG1的表达水平。用ox-LDL诱导Raw264.7巨噬细胞形成泡沫细胞，并研究FL对AMPKalpha/SREBP-1c通路和miR-33-5p的影响。结果：FL降低脂质水平和SREBP-1c表达，增加HDL-C，促进ABCA1和ABCG1介导的胆固醇外流，并减少主动脉胆固醇积累。AMPKalpha抑制剂dorsomorphin阻断FL在泡沫细胞中对细胞内胆固醇积累的抑制和SREBP1的下调作用。FL降低miR-33-5p表达，但上调PPARgamma，促进ABCA1和ABCG1介导的胆固醇外流。然而，miR-33-5p模拟物减少FL诱导的胆固醇外流，而miR-33-5p抑制剂则增加之。结论：FL可能通过修饰AMPKalpha/SREBP-1c通路并下调靶向胆固醇代谢基因（PPARgamma、ABCA1和ABCG1）的miR-33-5p，促进泡沫细胞胆固醇外流。这些发现为FL对AVI的保护作用提供了新的见解。
